body:
## Quick answer

You can buy Indian clothes online from **Bahe Kurtiz** in Jaipur and have them delivered to the UAE with **free express shipping and duties included** – nothing extra to pay on delivery. Ready sizes are dispatched in 7–10 working days and arrive about 5–10 business days later; every style can be stitched to your measurements at no extra cost.

## Sizes in UAE

Shops in the UAE use mixed size systems. Compare your bust in inches with our size chart or use the [size converter](/tools/indian-size-converter/) – or choose free custom fit.

## What to wear in UAE

For most of the year it is hot outside and air-conditioned inside: breathable cotton and lined georgette or chiffon work well, with a light dupatta for cool halls. Modest cuts with full sleeves suit many functions.

## Festivals and wedding season

Indian weddings in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Sharjah are often planned in the cooler months, and both Eid and Diwali are big celebrations for the community. See the exact last order dates for upcoming festivals below and on our [festival calendar](/festival/).

faq.q: How long does delivery to the UAE take?
faq.a: Ready sizes are dispatched in 7–10 working days and custom-fit pieces in 10–15 working days; express delivery then takes about 5–10 business days, with tracking.

faq.q: Will I pay customs duty in the UAE?
faq.a: No. We ship duties-paid (DDP), so duties and taxes are included and there is nothing to pay on delivery.

faq.q: Which currency will I pay in?
faq.a: Prices are in US dollars. Your card or PayPal is charged in USD and your bank converts it to dirhams.

faq.q: What if my size is not standard?
faq.a: Choose free custom fit and send your bust, waist, hip and height – we stitch the outfit to your measurements at no extra cost, up to size 3XL (4XL in our linen & velvet styles).
